title: Leaving Marshall to join Ham Crawford's band
summary: Kelly left high school around 1922 to go out with the Ham Crawford band and has worked as a musician since.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And, uh, well, we talked about your, the way you finished school, and, uh, several times, maybe, I don't remember. But, uh, what age were you when you first went off to play in a band?

Dick, I left Marshall about 1922. I, uh, my last half year in high school. I really didn't finish high school. And, uh, I went out with the Ham Crawford band, which we talked about before. And, uh, then I really never returned, except just to see my folks occasionally. But then on, I've been out in various capacities as a music man, or clarinetist, or saxophonist, or whatever.
